title: Acquirer: Ingram Micro; Target: Tech Pacific Australia Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Proposed acquisition of TechPac Holdings Limited by Ingram Micro Inc
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant market for consideration is the national market for the distribution of IT products.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisition of TechPac Holdings Limited by Ingram Micro Inc on the grounds that: 1.	Market concentration levels are unlikely to exceed the Commission's thresholds; 2.	The prospect of new entry or expansion of smaller firms; 3.	The presence of countervailing power of vendors and resellers; and 4.	Import competition is strong.
